title: Pacific City Fishing

services.name: Pacific City Fishing Promo
services.desc: The boat is backed into the water where it rolls off the trailer and is spun around to be bow facing to the ocean. The boat is walked/pushed through the surf until the water is deep enough to lower the motor and get under

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: While fishing off the stunning Cape Kiwanda you will be targeting many different species of Bottom Fish as well as Ling Cod, Dungeness Crab, and Salmon. This takes place in the best setting in Oregon. All gear is provided.
